why: The core fix is right: sat0 is taken from the provisional C.A before C.A is replaced, the list is redrawn only when dmSatWhy changes (either way: note removed or added), and the re-patch recomputes each row's lv.zw against the final C.A (dmPatch(C,lv,!lv.fx) uses the exact effect where one exists, else the quick one, as dmFill does). It cannot loop (dmRedraw is called once per dmFill, from the base 10,000-game promise, and it calls nothing that schedules another redraw), and it no-ops when DM_CTX has moved on. Reproduced: on the old build (eebc18f) probe-slow.js (10,000-game answer delayed 3s) leaves sat='' with the .dmsat note still on screen (note:true); on 07d4ef3 note:false, stable over 3 runs, and probe.js (no delay) is unchanged for shooting/fight/both. BUT the redraw loses user state. dmListHtml(C) draws folds from C.st.fold, which is the JSON copy taken when the screen was drawn; the toggle handler writes dmState().fold, not C.st. Probe (open the 'Not for this step', 'Not counted' and 'Modifiers' folds and focus a row while the answer is still provisional, then let the 10,000 games land): after the redraw all five folds are closed (outs/nc/more:false, while dmState().fold says true), focus drops to BODY, and the rows below the removed note jump 46px up on screen (dmAnchorKeep only holds a row the player tapped). The fix below copies dmState().fold into C.st.fold before redrawing, restores focus to the same data-dmlv, and, when the note being removed or added is above the top bar and no tap anchor is active, keeps the first visible row where it was. Verified on a built copy: folds stay open, focus kept, row top 221 -> 221, note gone, both row reasons ('already hits on 2+', 'no rule here needs it') shown; probe.js and probe-slow.js give the same results as 07d4ef3. Coverage: nothing else from the quick run stays stale. The card is redrawn in place; row effects/units are replaced by the exact ones as they come in; the picked profile's number is repainted here; the crowns come from dmBest at the end; dmMoreShow follows each repaint. The only C.A-derived text in dmListHtml is the .dmsat note. (dmFill's list rebuild in its ranking step has the same fold-state problem, and it predates this change: it also draws from C.st.fold, so a fold opened in the first second can close then. It needs the same one-line C.st.fold sync, or the sync can go in the toggle handler, which would cover both.) Snapshot: the committed defilers-and-friends.txt line 1609 'Nothing here changes this: the target is destroyed in every game anyway.' is wrong. The final answer wipes in 0.9938 of games, which is < 0.995, and the card reads '10 wounds lost · wiped in 99% of games' (line 1593). The same snapshot already shows the row reasons at 1647/1794, so it contradicted itself. node verify/run.js on 07d4ef3: everything PASS except snapshots, where the only change is defilers-and-friends.txt losing lines 1609-1610 (the note and its blank line). Restored afterwards.
